notes.title: Update 0.8 - Fun with Lava
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162391/3b3c64af0014ea1ba0486fc71a65762efe2618b0.png[/img]
Most importantly, an option has been added to the main menu to turn down the music. I know it isn't my forte, and I wanted to give you an option not to listen to it. I also fixed a major bug and now the player can pick up and eat/throw soldiers. More fun things. This took way more effort than I like to think about. Sorry it took so long.

[b]There is now a volcano in the game. [/b]

The 9th level is now finished and out, and I highly encourage you all to load up the game, get into the sacrificial feeling of October, and throw some people into the molten rock. Go ahead, see what happens. I promise it will be fun.

In the next update, I'm hoping to add another level, a few more languages, and maybe some new abilities for the Lizard.

Anyway, that's it for the week. Go eat some people.
